WordleMetadata.title: Daily Guess - Daily 5-Letter Word Puzzle | LetterLoop
WordleMetadata.description: Guess the daily 5-letter word in 6 tries, track your stats, and compare your run on today's leaderboard.

HelpModal.title: Daily Guess field guide
HelpModal.description: Guess the hidden 5-letter word in 6 tries. After each guess, the colors point you in the right direction so you can narrow it down fast.
HelpModal.seoDescription: Learn how Daily Guess works, what each tile color means, and how to read a guess with a real example.
HelpModal.spotlightTitle: Read the signal, then narrow it
HelpModal.spotlightDescription: Each row does two jobs at once: it locks confirmed letters and reroutes the ones that still need a better spot.

spotlightPoints.lock: Lock green letters first so the next guess has an anchor.
spotlightPoints.move: Keep yellow letters moving until they land in the right slot.
spotlightPoints.track: Use the keyboard as your running notebook between guesses.

basics.guess: Guess the hidden 5-letter word before you run out of tries.
basics.submit: Each guess has to be a real word. Type it in and hit Enter to lock it in.
basics.clues: After every guess, the tiles change color to show how close you are.

correct.title: Green
correct.exampleCaption: W is in the word and locked in place.

present.title: Yellow
present.exampleCaption: I is in the word, but not there.

absent.title: Gray
absent.description: That letter is not in the word.
absent.exampleCaption: U is not in the answer.

walkthroughPoints.two: R is in. Move it too.

HelpModal.walkthroughSummary: Keep C, R, A, and E. Drop N.
HelpModal.repeatsIntro: Gray does not always mean never. Sometimes it means too many.
HelpModal.repeatsSummary: APPLE has one L. The first L scores. The second one can miss.

tips.duplicates: Some answers use the same letter more than once, so don't rule out repeats too early.
tips.keyboard: The keyboard uses the same colors, so you can keep track of what you've learned at a glance.
tips.strategy: A strong opening word usually gives you more useful information if it mixes common vowels and consonants.

StackdownHelp.title: How to play
StackdownHelp.description: Clear a stack of letter tiles by finding all 6 hidden words. Fewer hints, more stars.
StackdownHelp.seoDescription: Learn how Stackdown works: pick exposed tiles to spell each hidden 5-letter word, spend hints wisely to keep your stars, and race the optional timer.
StackdownHelp.goal: Thirty letter tiles. Six hidden five-letter words. Find them all and the stack is gone — that's the whole game.

basics.pick: Tap a bright tile to pick it. Bright means nothing is sitting on top — dimmed tiles are buried for now.
basics.slot: Your tile pops into a slot up top, and lifting it might uncover fresh letters in the stack.
basics.submit: Fill all five slots and the word submits itself. Nail it and those tiles are gone for good.
basics.invalid: Spelled something that isn't the word? The tiles shake it off and slide right back into the stack. No harm done.
basics.undo: Changed your mind? Tap a letter in the slots to send it back — everything you picked after it goes too.

stack.exposedCaption: Nothing covers it, so it's yours for the taking.
stack.coveredCaption: Another tile sits on top. Clear the ones above to free it.

StackdownHelp.oneWord: At any moment, the word you're hunting can be spelled from the exposed letters — really, we promise it's in there. You might spot other words in the pile, but only that one clears tiles. If the stack looks impossible, look again.

hints.slider: Stuck? Choose Need a hint? below the stack, then swipe to reveal a clue for the word you're hunting — one per word.
hints.stars: You start every game with 6 stars, and each hint costs one. Clear the stack hint-free for a perfect run.
hints.floor: Finishing always earns at least 1 star — but the bragging rights live at 6.

timer.runs: The clock starts when the puzzle loads and pauses itself whenever you leave the tab.
timer.hidden: It's hidden by default so the game stays chill. Tap the clock icon if you like the pressure.
timer.score: Time never touches your stars — those are all about hints. Finish a stack and you'll get a timecard for each word, plus your best time ever.

tips.whichTile: Two tiles can show the same letter but hide different things underneath — which one you pick matters.
tips.daily: A fresh stack drops every day, and practice mode deals a random one whenever you want.
tips.leaderboard: The leaderboard ranks by stars first, then by fastest clear.

Strands.unavailable: Today's puzzle is not available yet.
Strands.gridInstructions: Use arrow keys to move between letters. Press Enter or Space to add a letter; activate the last selected letter again to submit.
Strands.progressSummary: Found {found} of {total} words in this weave

feedback.spangramEdge: Main path has to touch opposite edges
feedback.unknown: That thread is not in the list

StrandsHelp.title: Theme Weave field guide
StrandsHelp.description: Build words by tracing connected letters across the board. Find every theme word, plus the main path that spans the puzzle.

boardRead.edges: Sweep the outside edge early. Main paths often reveal themselves there first.
boardRead.clusters: When a word cluster appears, clear the short theme words before chasing the longest route.
boardRead.pivot: Once the theme clicks, trace the main path across the opposite edges to close the weave.

basics.drag: Trace through neighboring letters in any of the eight directions, or click one letter at a time to build a path.
basics.submit: Tap the last selected letter again to submit the word you traced.
basics.find: Find all theme words hidden on the board to finish the puzzle. Theme words can be traced forward or backward.

StrandsHelp.spangram: One answer is the main path. It describes the theme and must connect two opposite edges of the board.

hints.charge: Three extra valid words that are not theme answers fill the hint meter.
hints.reveal: When the meter is full, use Hint to reveal part of an unfinished answer.

StrandsHelp.hintLoopTitle: How charge turns into a reveal

hintLoop.bank: Every extra valid word banks progress toward the next reveal.
hintLoop.spend: A full meter reveals a live segment from one unfinished answer.
hintLoop.timing: Spend it after your scan slows down, not on the first stall.

tips.words: Theme answers stay highlighted so you can keep track of what is already solved.
tips.mode: Daily mode gives you the fixed puzzle for today, while Practice deals a fresh board anytime.

Wordplay.hintAria: Reveal the starting letter of a hidden word for {cost} coins
Wordplay.allCompleteDescription: You traced every hidden word across all {count} levels. Incredible run!

WordplayHelp.title: How to play
WordplayHelp.description: Trace connected letters on the board to find every hidden word and clear the level.
WordplayHelp.seoDescription: Learn how Word Trail works: drag across neighboring letters to spell the hidden target words, earn coins for bonus words, and spend them on hints.
WordplayHelp.goal: Each level hides a handful of words on a letter grid. Trace them all to finish the level and unlock the next one — 200 levels, growing from 3×3 up to 6×6 boards.

basics.trace: Press a letter and drag through its neighbors — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Each cell can be used only once per trace.
basics.submit: Lift your finger to submit the word you traced. You can also tap letters one by one, then tap the last letter again to submit.
basics.slots: The blank slots up top show the length of every hidden word. Find one and its slot lights up with the answer.

WordplayHelp.bonus: Trace a real word that isn't one of the targets and it counts as a bonus word, earning you 2 coins. Cells are never locked, so keep hunting even after a word is found.

hints.earn: You start with 30 coins, earn 2 per bonus word, and 10 for every level you complete.
hints.hint: Stuck? Spend 25 coins on a hint to flash the starting cell of a word you haven't found yet.

tips.direction: Words can be traced forwards or backwards — both directions count.
tips.reuse: Letters are reusable: the same cell can be part of many different words.
tips.progress: Your progress and coins save automatically, and sync across devices when you sign in.
